regressions.description: Two deferred renderer CAS failures. Before is an isolated reconstruction of the pre-fix service, with repository product files untouched; exact source/tests and reproduction note retained in service-cas-before/.

Four new-entry feature tests fail against explicit not-implemented stub, then pass. Host old length-as-zero and unbounded lookup were established by code review, not claimed as executable old-main failures.
Existing context helper ignored per-operation remaining budgets. One real failing regression, then all 8 helper tests pass.
Existing plugin selection prefilter changed cached fragments. One real failing regression, then all 14 external plugin tests pass.

reviewFindingsAddressed: Parent service captures source object and immutable document ID/version and accepts formal window.documentVersion.
View owner marks optimistic window text unavailable until committed source version matches.
New bounded navigation helper avoids optional length and byte length, validates both UTF-16 endpoints, checks cancellation/CAS after each read, and rejects oversized lines.
Parent service passes remaining scan budgets and stops no-progress retries.
Footnotes returns selection-independent fragments; host retains editing source and restores previews.
limitations: Footnote index caps remain 8 Mi UTF-16 / 200000 lines / 4096 combined definitions and references; partial indexes never assert undefined.
Unsupported nested or unprovable opaque context falls back to source.
Navigation rejects an oversized intermediate line instead of reading it without a budget.
Definition preview replaces only the marker; body/continuations retain original editor mapping.
Native UI acceptance is coordinated by parent and is not claimed by this report.
